page.layout: One column of dictionary entries, with Hebrew, Chaldee, Syriac and Greek words; running head at top centre; page number at top right; catchword at the foot right.

main_text.p: דנן Chald. Idem. כרנן Sic. למא דנן Ad quid, Quorsum, Quare?

דנא Ch. Meditari, eloqui. Ethpeh. אתדנן Syr. Attendere alicui, auscultare, obedire, obtemperare; Hebr. און: ut Part. [illegible, ~12 letters] Qui attendebat, seu parebat ipsi, Act.10.7. Infinit. [illegible, ~8 letters] Et noluerunt attedere ei, Act.7.39.
דנב Ch. Cauda. Plur. דנבין. Ex Hebraeo זנב, mutato ז in ד.
דנח Ch. & Syr. Oriri, exoriri. Heb. זרח. Ex Aphel Partic. [illegible, ~10 letters] Qui oriri facit solem suum, Matth.5.45.
מרנחא Chald. [illegible, ~6 letters] Syr. Oriens, Orientalis plaga mundi.
מרנחא, מרנח Chald. Ortus: Itern Oriens.
[illegible, ~5 letters] Syriace usurpatur in titulis Euangeliorum pro eo quod Graeci dixerunt Ἐπιφανία, Epiphania.
דנק Ithpeh. אתדנק, Ithpaal. אתדנק Chald. Gemuit, ingemuit, suspiravit. Videtur ad אנק referendum, ut sit pro אתנק, ת mutato in ד.
דנר Ch. & Syr. Denarius, Exod.30.13. in Jon. Matth.22.19. Plural. דינרין, 2.Reg.5.5. emphat. Syr. [illegible, ~4 letters] Denarii, Δηνάεια.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and pointed forms were only partly legible on the scan; the vocalised Syriac and Hebrew strings in the entries are marked illegible where the letters could not be read with confidence. The Greek word Epiphania is rendered as printed; its exact letters are uncertain. The catchword at the foot right is the Hebrew word דסק.
